That depends on the specific electoral system and the rules established for that particular election. In many places, voting-by-mail ballots may be submitted before or on election day, but some jurisdictions allow for extended deadlines or weekend drop-off periods for convenience. However, these rules can vary significantly by location and election cycle.

To confirm the exact deadlines and procedures for your area, please check the official election website, contact your local election office, or refer to any official communications regarding the voting process.
